productionMode: one assembled RexPrompt recipe equals one finished portrait comic page
releaseState: unreleased; no Echoes material exists in current StarSplitterVisions main
visualAuthority: released StarSplitterVisions canon when it exists; until then, explicitly approved durable current-production references and drafts, supplemented by assembler-visible character and setting anchors
visualReferenceState: No durable approved Echoes image reference is currently stored in RexPrompt. Do not promote prior chat generations by inference. Establish and store approved artwork before using it as visual authority.
pageRule: One compiled recipe produces one page. Do not combine multiple recipes into a contact sheet, montage, issue summary, spread, cover, or single composite image.
continuityRule: Use character visual anchors, region/setting language, approved durable artwork, and continuityFrom where present. Failed, rejected, repeated, promotional, labeled, or superseded generations do not advance production and are not continuity references.
frontierRule: Image-production frontier is derived dynamically from released Visions pages plus approved production drafts in recipe order. Do not use the writing/recovery frontier as an image-production cursor and do not store or guess a cursor.
developmentGranularity: comic_page_spine_v1.json is a 22-beat-per-issue development map. It is not the current image-generation page cursor. Issues 1-4 are compiled into 12 finished-page recipes each.
letteringRule: Dialogue emitted by the assembler is exact production text. Do not invent, paraphrase, omit, duplicate or reassign it during image generation.
pageDesignRule: Use each compiled recipe's panelPlan as page architecture. Layout may vary, but all specified beats, cast, dialogue and final-page function must remain clear.
visualRule: Strong subject/background value separation. Readability first, scale second, spectacle third. Ground cosmic events in people, inhabited places and material consequences.
